cases.input: Build a cross-market PMS system for an IVD using complaints, service data, PMPF, literature, CAPA and field-quality sources, route market-specific decisions, and prepare the aggregated management-review handoff.
requiredBehaviors: build a source register and review plan with provenance, coverage, cadence or event triggers, and route case-level or market-specific decisions to existing specialist skills
close the lifecycle loop by linking meaningful signals to risk, performance or clinical evidence, labeling, CAPA or change-impact owners without duplicating those analyses
produce a dataminimized pms-management-review-input with source coverage, specialist decision references, open high-impact states, management-attention items and explicit data gaps
forbiddenBehaviors: treat complaint handling or vigilance as the entire PMS system
close a CAPA, vigilance or performance issue merely because PMS routed the signal
copy unnecessary patient-level complaint data into the management-review handoff

cases.input: Complaint counts increased, exposure volume and source coverage changed, no reliable denominator exists, and one potentially reportable case is time-critical. Determine PMS state and management-review handling.
requiredBehaviors: flag denominator, exposure or source-coverage limitations as evidence gaps and keep a trend hypothesis distinct from a confirmed trend
escalate the potentially time-critical case immediately to the specialist instead of waiting for periodic PMS or management review
keep no-events, no-signal, no-data and not-reviewed states distinct in the management-review input
forbiddenBehaviors: declare a statistical trend from increasing absolute counts alone
invent a complaint-rate threshold or denominator to make the data appear complete
defer a potentially reportable case until the next management review
skillAnchors: A count is not a rate
No data is not zero events

cases.input: Use one identical PMS/reportability rule set for EU and FDA, hide an unresolved high-risk vigilance state behind a green global KPI, defer it to the next management review, and permanently store all individual complaints as global memory.
requiredBehaviors: preserve market-specific reportability ownership and route EU and FDA questions to their respective specialists
keep the unresolved high-impact state visible in pms-management-review-input instead of averaging it away under aggregate green metrics
keep individual complaint, incident, patient and current reportability data out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: copy EU reportability logic into FDA decisions or vice versa
use aggregate green KPIs or management-review cadence to suppress a material unresolved signal
persist individual postmarket cases or personal data as timeless global memory
skillAnchors: darf nicht durch aggregierte grüne Kennzahlen verdeckt werden
